scope: Local combined validation of the three correctness findings in release PR110. Hosted release acceptance and wheel checks run separately; no publication.

changes.before: Conversion succeeds but archive validation reports missing implicit-content/buffer.bin.
changes.after: Declared buffers, images and schemas are packed at the relocated URI base without changing source bytes.
regressions: Validate complete external glTF and GLB archives
Independently import extracted buffers and decode images
Nested/dot URIs, deduplication and a schema referring to the original document
Unsafe/missing resources and generated-name collisions preserve previous output

changes.before: Valid longitude180 vertices fail because a synthetic normal probe exceeds180.
changes.after: Actual coordinates are strictly validated before periodic longitude or inward one-sided derivative sampling; a resolver promotion recomputes the complete batch.
regressions: Date-line and near-pole positions in degrees and grads
Independent WGS84 world positions/normals and analytic projected Albers derivative
Strict native epoch and projected metre/foot/US-foot operations
Invalid source positions and singular geographic-pole normals fail atomically

changes.finding: Case-distinct GeoJSON properties in SQLite filters
changes.before: A/a properties cause duplicate-column errors even for keep=1 and constant0 filters.
changes.after: Unrelated and constant filters work; ambiguous direct SQLite identifiers are explicitly refused using placeholder columns and a read authorizer. Original property names/values are retained.
regressions: String literals, spaces, quoted keywords and Unicode names
Empty and matching published archives; source and prior-output preservation
Existing filter security and exact-integer checks
changes.payloadCheck: Matching filtered GLB payload is byte-identical to the unfiltered pre-fix reproduction.
changes.reuseImpact: Existing source fingerprint includes portable.rs; changing that reader requires a fresh portable reuse baseline.

pythonOracleSuite.skipReason: Optional external geodiff integrations are not configured.

outputDigests: Two existing digest tests pass in both profiles; one opt-in export helper remains ignored.

localBuild.nativeSQLite: Shared system SQLite; override unset for standard builds

windowsTestFollowup.finding: The new extracted-resource regression kept its ZipArchive inspection handle open during forced replacement; Windows returned Access is denied.
windowsTestFollowup.change: Close the inspection reader after extraction, retaining all replacement and byte-equality assertions. Production code is unchanged.
windowsTestFollowup.hostedVerification: See the current Windows CLI check on PR112 for the rerun.
